content:
We got template info. It seems to be a disconnection of sulfonyl chloride? The forward reaction: Cl-SO2-Ar + C-O-Ar' -> product with sulfonamide? Actually retro: target contains sulfonamide linking aromatic ring to sulfonyl group attached to phenyl-F. Template likely breaks the S-N bond and forms sulfonyl chloride and an aniline? Let's apply to target to get precursors.

Use apply_template with target SMILES and template_id 20810.
